_readme: Site metadata for link previews. When you publish (e.g. GitHub Pages), set 'url' to the full site address ending in '/', e.g. https://yourname.github.io/loeg/ . Link-preview images need an absolute URL, so og:image/og:url are only emitted when 'url' is set. Rebuild after editing.
